fallback: If the button doesn't work, paste this link into your browser:

verify.subject: Confirm your {app} email
verify.heading: Confirm your email
verify.body: Confirm this address and your clubs save to your account, so they appear on every device you sign in on.
verify.footer: This link works for 24 hours. If you didn't sign up, ignore this email and no account is kept.

reset.subject: Reset your {app} password
reset.heading: Set a new password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your account. If it was you, choose a new one with the button below.
reset.footer: This link works for one hour. If you didn't ask for it, ignore this email and your password stays the same.
